name: Coarse-to-Fine NeRF
definition: A sampling strategy that performs two tiers of sampling to improve detail learning. A coarse network determines where space is opaque, and a second set of samples is created based on that opacity to train a fine network.
summary: Coarse-to-Fine NeRF is a hierarchical sampling strategy that improves high-frequency detail learning by using a coarse network to identify opaque regions and clustering fine samples there, setting it apart from uniform sampling by adaptively concentrating computational effort on visible geometry.
